Collagerator was an interactive Mac / PC software made by Tomi Knuutila as a Master of Arts graduation piece in the University of Arts and Design Helsinki, Media Lab in 2000. The user first selected three images with the keyboard, after which the images were combined to a collage, which was uploaded to the web and could be printed also in certain exhibition occasions.
